messages:
rachel (sales): Quick: BankCo wants a 2-week POC. Requirements: EU-only data residency, full subproc certs, BYOK in their AWS account, and an estimate for 2 p50s with burst. They flagged "no non-EU egress" in RFP.

devon (solutions): I can draft tech answers. Clarify failover: strict reject vs EU-only failover?

rachel (sales): They insisted on "never leave EU" unless a signed DR SOP. So default should be reject; we can offer documented EU-failover as an option.

mina (eng): Our options: 1) tenant geo-pin + reject if no capacity, 2) tenant geo-pin + EU-only failover, 3) queue/timeout. For a banking POC I'd suggest EU-only failover (safer).

tom (security): Subprocessors for EU: AWS (eu-west-1/2), Cloudflare (edge), Fastly (optional CDN), Datadog (monitoring). I uploaded certs. BYOK flow: customer provides CMK ARN + cross-account role; we never export keys. Note: cross-account KMS requires an addendum.

finance-bot: Ballpark POC cost: 2x p50 reserved pro-rate + network + BYOK add-on + SRE on-call = ~USD 28k for 2 weeks (estimate). Detailed line items pending.

devon (solutions): I'll assemble: subproc cert pack link, BYOK blurb, recommended routing snippet, and the finance estimate. Posting draft in 60m.

rachel (sales): Thanks all. Please include explicit statement about logs/audit (per-request region and egress path) for their SOC review.

tom (security): Will add auditability note and KMS access logging guidance.

rachel (sales): Perfect. After draft I'll send to BankCo. :thumbsup:
